properties.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued June 28 at 8:59PM CDT until June 28 at 9:30PM CDT by NWS Bismarck ND
properties.description:

miles southeast of Garrison, moving northeast at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Ping pong ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect wind
damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Garrison, Underwood, Max, Riverdale, Pick City, Coleharbor,
Benedict, Hazen Bay Recreation Area, Beulah Bay Recreation Area,
Ruso City, Ruso, Fort Stevenson State Park, Lake Sakakawea State
Park, Emmet, Dakota Waters Recreation Area, White Shield and
Strawberry Lake.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.
